module_quizzes.title: Accessible spaces are reserved at all hours for properly plated or permitted vehicles from which the person with the qualifying disability enters or exits. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Do not park in the access aisle beside an accessible parking stall. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: The printed accessible-parking fine maxima are one hundred fifty dollars for a first offense, three hundred for a second and five hundred for a third. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Blocking a curb cut or wheelchair ramp can result in an accessibility-ramp violation ticket. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Rail crossings may have a round advance sign, crossbuck, white X or RR pavement text, a no-passing marking or a stop line. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Approach railroad tracks at a controlled speed that allows a stop if necessary; always expect rail traffic. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Stop for an approaching-train signal, lowered gate, flagman's warning or a crossing stop sign. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: A visible train or audible train whistle requires a stop when crossing would be hazardous. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Stop at the railroad stop line; without one, stop between fifteen and fifty feet from the nearest rail. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Never drive through, around or beneath a railroad gate or barrier. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: After stopping, check every track and confirm there is enough room for the entire car beyond the rails. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Expect buses and hazardous-material trucks to stop at railroad crossings. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Do not shift gears while traversing tracks, and watch for additional trains or on-track equipment. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: If a vehicle stalls on a crossing, get everyone out of the vehicle and off the tracks immediately. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: After evacuation, the manual directs use of the crossing sign's emergency number when no train is visible, to try to stop rail traffic. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Keep clear of the tracks if rail traffic is approaching; the emergency instructions also direct a call to nine-one-one. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: An ENS sign is typically blue and provides a continuously available railroad-dispatch emergency contact at or near the crossing or crossbuck. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Railroad dispatchers answering the ENS number can attempt to stop trains at the crossing during an emergency. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: The DOT number below an ENS dispatch number identifies the precise crossing being reported. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: ENS reports can describe malfunctioning warning equipment, disabled vehicles blocking tracks, trespassers or other unsafe crossing conditions. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Use added caution at rail crossings because trains and other on-track equipment cannot stop quickly. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Never race a train or other on-track equipment across the tracks. practice

module_quizzes.domain: Passing interactions, turns, parking and rail crossings
module_quizzes.title: Avoid gear changes on railroad tracks because a stalled vehicle can be left in danger. practice
